about: Persistent decision and moment echoes for Last Light Academy (doc 24 section 5.2 and section 5.4). Maps choice_id/option_id or moment_id to later scene echoes ({scene_id, kind, target_id, text}). Chapter 1 pack covers D1 (EX-CH01-S01-CHOICE) and D2 (EX-CH01-S04-CHOICE).
consumer_rules: An echo fires only when its choice option (or moment) is in story_log and the player is in its scene_id; it is never shown before then.
When an echo fires, its text becomes a 'Where it showed up again' line under the linked Decision entry.
choices and moments are lookup maps of the same rows listed in entries; the M1-50 check keeps them identical.

decisions.title: Where should spare commissioning energy go?
decisions.body: Routing spare sunlight to stored air or the planting bay saves a dated Day-one photo that returns in Chapter 8.
decisions.reconnection: Both options reach the fixed 25 April P-02 survival baseline.

EX-CH01-S01-OPT01.label: Store air
EX-CH01-S01-OPT01.immediate_consequence: The air gauge rises in the commissioning exercise and a Day-one photo of the rising gauge is saved.

EX-CH01-S01-OPT02.label: Light the planting bay
EX-CH01-S01-OPT02.immediate_consequence: The empty planting bench glows warm and a Day-one photo of the lit bay is saved.

decisions.title: How is the notebook organised?
decisions.body: Setting up the Growth Record as paired photographs or a paired conditions table keeps that layout across every garden comparison.
decisions.reconnection: Both layouts hold the same dated care records and plant identities.

EX-CH01-S04-OPT01.label: Paired photographs
EX-CH01-S04-OPT01.immediate_consequence: The Growth Record opens in the paired-photographs layout.

EX-CH01-S04-OPT02.immediate_consequence: The Growth Record opens in the paired-conditions table layout.
